 Tis the season for the Low Income  Home Energy Assistance Program.

 LIHEAP season opens to help households cope with heating bills 
 By PATRICK CLOONAN
pcloonan@indianagazette.net 
 PAT CLOONAN 
 Author email 
 Nov 2, 2026 
 Nov 2, 2026 
 Updated 
 8 mins ago 
 Facebook

 The Pennsylvania Department of Human Services said Monday that the 2026-27 Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program season has opened, with applications being accepted now through April 23, 2027.
 “Pennsylvanians need to be able to heat their homes and keep themselves and their families warm through the winter, and LIHEAP helps hundreds of thousands of Pennsylvanians each year stay safe and healthy during the coldest months of the year,” said DHS Secretary Dr. Val Arkoosh. “Anyone who may need help with heating costs and keeping their home safe through this winter should apply for LIHEAP as soon as possible.”
